text:
```yaml
name: Java Bulk CDK Base Publish

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'airbyte-cdk/bulk/core/base/**'

jobs:
  publish-base:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up JDK 11
        uses: actions/setup-java@v2
        with:
          java-version: '11'
          distribution: 'adopt'

      - name: Cache Gradle dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v2
        with:
          path: ~/.gradle/caches
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-${{ hashFiles('**/*.gradle*') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-gradle-

      - name: Check version
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:base:checkVersion

      - name: Build
        if: success()
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:base:publishToMavenLocal

      - name: Publish
        if: success()
        run: |
          ./gradlew :airbyte-cdk:bulk:core:base:publish
```
